description: Election Commission - Mr. W. M. A. Jayawardhana of the Ja-ela Pradeshiya Sabba has Vecated his Office of member of that P/S - Mr. M. S. Chandana and Mr. M. M. Mohamad Rifas were resigned from the Minuwangoda U/C
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Ja-Ela Pradeshiya Sabha and Minuwangoda Urban Council) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters such as candidate registrations, vacating of offices, and electoral commission decisions.
